unique_source_of_truth_for: mode parameters (k ladder, PRF, squint envelope)
meta.rule: Downstream tickets (D2 mode mapping, D4 duration layering, D5 maneuver model, D7 AASR) must REFERENCE values in this file; copying numbers into code/spec is forbidden. Parameters Kim 2021 does not publish are null with a note -- inventing values is forbidden (ticket 02).
meta.source_citation: Kim, H.; Park, J.; Chang, Y.-K.; Lee, S.-H. Optimal Attitude Maneuvering Analyses for Imaging at Squint Staring and Sliding Spotlight Modes of SAR Satellite. Aerospace 2021, 8, 277. https://doi.org/10.3390/aerospace8100277
meta.page_convention: Page numbers refer to the PDF page footer 'N of 33' (the PDF has 33 pages).

extraction.method: Direct reading of the PDF original (all 33 pages); auxiliary txt used for search only. Tables 2 and 3 transcribed table-by-table.

band.kim_source: p.19 section 3.1 text: 'SAR satellites use the frequency bandwidth of the X-band'

frequency_ghz.kim_source: p.19 section 3.1 text: 'operating frequency of the X-band SAR satellite is assumed to be 9.6 GHz'

wavelength_m.kim_source: Table 2, p.19 ('Wavelength 0.031 m'); also p.19 text 'wavelength (lambda) is about 0.031 m'

altitude_km.kim_source: Table 2, p.19 ('Satellite Altitude 570 km'); also p.19 text 'altitude of the satellite is 570 km'

orbit_inclination_deg.kim_source: Table 2, p.19 ('Orbit Inclination 45 deg.'); also p.19 text 'angle of inclination is 45 degree'

satellite_moi_kgm2.kim_source: Table 2, p.19 ('Satellite MOI [Ix Iy Iz] [1000 kgm2 700 kgm2 500 kgm2]'); also p.19 text 'Ix = 1000 kgm2, Iy = 700 kgm2, Iz = 500 kgm2'

cmg_max_torque_nm.kim_source: Table 2, p.19 ('CMG Max Torque [60 Nm 60 Nm 60 Nm]'); also p.19 text 'torque of tau_x,y,z = 60Nm'

cmg_angular_momentum_nms.kim_source: Table 2, p.19 ('CMG Angular Momentum 40 Nms'); also p.19 text '|H_CMG| = 40 Nms'

stabilization_time_s.kim_source: Table 2, p.19 ('Stabilization Time 2 s'); also p.4 text 'a stabilization time of 2 s is arbitrarily assumed'

mode_set.kim_source: Paper title (p.1) and sections 2.3.1 (p.5, staring spotlight) / 2.3.2 (p.7, sliding spotlight)
mode_set.note: Kim analyzes squint variants only; no stripmap (STR) parameters are published in Kim 2021. STR tier parameters must come from the D2 mapping ticket's reference source (TerraSAR-X ladder, mapping-reference only).

squint_angle_range_deg.kim_source: Table 2, p.19 ('Squint Angle +-12 deg.'); usage: p.20 text 'squint angle of 12 degrees from the first target ... not less than -12 at imaging of the last target'; p.27 text 'squint angle of this mission was within the range of +-12'
squint_angle_range_deg.maps_to: spec D5 alpha envelope / squint interval axis

sliding_factor_k_ladder.note: NOT PUBLISHED: Kim describes sliding spotlight geometrically (rotation center below the ground surface, p.7/p.9 Fig.5) and publishes no discrete k values or k ladder. Frozen later by the SLS blocking gate (spec Further Notes); TerraSAR-X k ladder may serve as mapping reference only, Kim-first arbitration applies.

prf_hz.note: NOT PUBLISHED: no pulse repetition frequency appears anywhere in Kim 2021. Required by the AASR ticket (spec D7); that ticket must source PRF elsewhere and register the source here by manifest write-back.

alpha_max.note: NOT PUBLISHED as an explicit number: Kim publishes no maximum angular acceleration. An indirect bound is derivable from Table 2 (max torque / MoI, both registered under platform.*); the derivation convention (per-axis vs min-axis, margin) is a D5 maneuver-ticket decision and must be recorded there, not invented here.

j_max_rad_s3.note: NOT PUBLISHED as a hard limit: Figure 17b (p.23) shows a realized jerk profile of about +-20 rad/s^3 for the 3 s verification case only -- that is a result plot, not a design limit. The D5 ticket freezes the fallback conservative bound + alarm per the spec escape hatch (Testing Decisions, Kim RMT entry).

k1_sec.kim_source: p.19 section 3.1 text: 'k_1 ... is set as 1 sec'

k2_rad2_per_sec2.kim_source: p.19 section 3.1 text: 'k_2 is set to 100 rad2/sec2'

objective_weights.note: Weights of Kim's retargeting objective J (Eq. 37, p.16). Recorded for RMT-provenance completeness; not platform limits.

sat_calibration.role: Duration-model literature calibration fixture (spec Testing Decisions: Kim SAT 8.08-8.38 s; US3 unit-test reproduction target).

squint_staring_per_target_s.kim_source: Table 3, p.29 (Scenario 1, Phase 1 per-target SAT in parentheses)

squint_staring_range_s.kim_source: p.25 section 3.3 text: 'the SAT in Phase 1 took about 8.08-8.38 s for all four targets (25% margin was considered)'

sat_margin_fraction.kim_source: p.7 ('a margin of 25% is considered in addition to the staring spotlight mode SAT obtained from Equations (7) or (11)'); p.11 ('a margin of 25% is considered in addition to SAT at the sliding spotlight mode obtained from Equations (19) or (24)'); p.25 text
sat_margin_fraction.maps_to: spec D4 C2 inter-task transfer pad 25% maneuver margin (Kim semantics)

scenario2_total_mission_s.kim_source: Table 3, p.29; also p.28 text 'the longest time was taken at 49.87 s'

rmt_reference.maps_to: spec D5 RMT calibration fixture (jerk-aware maneuver closure; reproduction failure falls back to conservative bound per spec escape hatch)

incidence_angle_deg.kim_source: p.20 text 'imaging at the center of the AoI and at an angle of incidence of 45'; p.27 text 'incidence angle for each target was around 45'

label: Scenario 1
Scenario 2
end_of_imaging_squint_deg.kim_source: p.25 ('squint angle at the end of imaging was -7.92') and p.28 ('squint angle at the end of imaging was -10.26')
end_of_imaging_squint_deg.note: Result values, recorded only as sanity anchors for duration-model reproduction tests.

resolution_m.kim_source: Table 2, p.19 ('Resolution 0.5 m x 0.5 m'); also p.1 abstract 'four high resolution images of 5 km x 5 km'

fine_band_anchor_m.kim_source: Table 2, p.19 -- the ONLY resolution grade published in Kim 2021

coarse_band_m.note: NOT PUBLISHED: Kim provides a single resolution grade, so a coarse/fine two-band ladder cannot be extracted from Kim alone. The coarse band (and the boundary-zone definition used by the cheap-ablation prereg) is frozen by the D2 mode-mapping ticket; TerraSAR-X tier ladder may serve as mapping reference ONLY, with Kim-first conflict arbitration (spec Testing Decisions, Kim Table 2/3 entry). Until frozen, scenario generation must refuse to run C/F/H demand tiers (fail loud, no silent default).

consumers: scenario_manifest_template.json prereg.rho_req_distribution (binds by reference, never copies values)

aoi_km.kim_source: Table 2 (continuation), p.20 ('Area of Interest 20 km x 20 km'); also p.1 abstract

scene_size_km.kim_source: Table 2, p.19 ('Swath Width 5 km x 5 km'); p.7 section 2.3.2 'maximum scene length in the direction of the azimuth and the range is set to 5 km'

scene_height_variation_m.unit: m (point target to scene corner height difference)
scene_height_variation_m.kim_source: p.7 section 2.3.2 text: 'the height difference between the coordinates of the point target and the corner of the scene is up to 4 m'

n_targets_kim.note: Kim's demonstration size only; Paper 2 scenario densities follow spec D10 (N=20/100/300/500), not this value.
